newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives slide in new opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives slide in new opinion poll.

text.p: Britain's ruling Conservative Party has lost support after last month's budget and two weeks of renewed internal party turmoil over Europe, according to an opinion poll published in Thursday's edition of The Times.

The MORI poll showed support for the Conservatives at 30 percent, down three points from a month ago, compared with support for Labour up one point to 51 percent, and the minority Liberal Democrats also up one point, to 13 percent.
MORI interviewed 1,872 adults at 169 sampling points between December 6 and 9. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
